entries.description: Read guiding-principles.md and lessons-learned.md
Confirmed ShellSessionStateLoader, IRoleSwitcher, SecurityConfigurationManager, RoleSwitching.AllowedRoles
Created UserContextBar.razor + code-behind with three-link sentence, enable/disable logic, role and org menus, sign-out dialog open
Created SignOutConfirmationDialog.razor using IMudDialogInstance and DialogResult.Ok(true)
Wired role menu with allowed-switch roles via IRoleSwitcher; org menu reuses /auth/switch-organization redirect
Added 7 bUnit tests covering enable/disable matrix (SystemAdmin, Customer, BackofficeUserAdmin, BackofficeUser), testid presence, sentence structure, sign-out dialog opens

Full solution build clean; all 7 new UserContextBar tests pass. Pre-existing test failure WorkflowAssetSmokeTests.AiRouterConfig_LoadsNestedPromptTemplates due to missing docs/workflow-auth-observability.md removed in commit 8730107 — unrelated to this session.
Cross-provider session verification via router (session-verification task)

Addressed verifier Minor #5 (test coverage: confirm/cancel navigation) and Minor #7 (Dispose null-check). Deferred other items with rationale (verifier self-downgraded Majors; remaining Minors not behavioral defects).
Re-verification after round-1 remediation (complexity_hint=85 per Major-flag policy)

Removed lines 27-84 in MainLayout.razor (active-org summary, Switch-Org menu, DabblerRoleSwitcher, user-icon menu, dividers). Inserted <UserContextBar /> with UserName, UserRoles, ActiveOrganizationName, OrganizationOptions parameters.
Removed @using Dabbler.Security.Blazor.Components, _activeOrganizationKey field, SwitchOrganizationAsync method. Kept _isAdmin/_isSystemAdmin (used by nav drawer).
data-testid='active-organization-label' preserved on the org link span via UserContextBar's _orgLinkAttributes dictionary (verified in bUnit tests from Session 1).

Conformance tests MudBlazorRebuildConformanceTests still pass (no structural count changes needed; MainLayout still contains MudLayout/MudAppBar/MudDrawer/MudMainContent/MudNavMenu/MudNavLink/MudThemeProvider).

Updated PlaywrightFixture.SwitchOrganizationFromShellAsync to click the org-link data-testid='active-organization-label' instead of the removed 'Switch org' button. Ran full Playwright suite: 67/75 passed. 8 failures are PRE-EXISTING on master (confirmed by stashed-baseline re-run) and unrelated to Session 2: drawer 'Admin'/'Retail Businesses' text not visible, layout-spacing assertion, ReportValidation enablement. These were not caused by the MainLayout/UserContextBar swap.

dotnet build: 0 warnings, 0 errors. dotnet test (unit/integration, no Playwright): 525 passed, 1 pre-existing failure (WorkflowAssetSmokeTests.AiRouterConfig_LoadsNestedPromptTemplates, unrelated, already logged in Session 1). dotnet test Playwright: 67/75 passed, 8 pre-existing failures confirmed unchanged from master baseline.
Cross-provider session verification via router (session-verification task)

Added role="group" aria-label="User context" on the bar; aria-hidden="true" on the "as"/"for" connectors so screen readers read the three aria-labeled links coherently; confirmed keyboard tab order follows DOM (User → Role → Org) and MudLink disabled state renders non-focusable spans.

Added .user-context-bar CSS class with max-width/text-overflow:ellipsis truncation on user and org names (18ch default, 12ch ≤960px, 8ch ≤600px); role name stays un-truncated (known short values); added HTML title attribute on user/org links so hover exposes full value when truncated.

No-op: grep for old-cluster references under docs/ found only session-set change logs and the Dabbler.Security.Blazor README for the library-local DabblerRoleSwitcher; no image assets in docs/ pictured the old cluster.

Added 4 new bUnit tests to UserContextBarTests: Bar_HasGroupRoleAndAriaLabel_ForScreenReaders, ConnectorWords_AreAriaHidden, UserAndOrgLinks_ExposeTitleAttribute_ForHoverTooltip, Links_CarryResponsiveCssClasses_ForTruncation. 13/13 UserContextBar tests pass.

Verified AppbarText=#424242 on AppbarBackground=#FFFFFF yields 9.6:1 contrast (WCAG AAA 7:1 for normal text passes). MudLink disabled state uses reduced opacity but disabled controls are exempt from WCAG 1.4.3 per spec note.

dotnet build: 0 errors, 19 pre-existing warnings. dotnet test (non-Playwright): 529 passed, 1 pre-existing failure (WorkflowAssetSmokeTests.AiRouterConfig_LoadsNestedPromptTemplates — same pre-existing failure logged in Session 1 and Session 2). dotnet test Playwright: 75/75 passed, zero failures (Session 2s 8 pre-existing failures were fixed in commit 6791ae4 between sessions).
